title: ArticleLeadContent
description: Article lead content: the heading, the lead paragraph, a cover picture, the author with the portrait and the date. One object is valid in every article lead layout (the cover above, at the start, at the end).

description.description: one paragraph under the heading; empty: none

image.description: address of the cover picture; none: the placeholder

imageAlt.description: alt text of the cover picture

avatar.description: address of the portrait of the author; none: the placeholder

date.description: the date as it is shown
